places.name: Metropolitan Cathedral of Santa Fe
places.address: Plaza 25 de Mayo, Santa Fe, Argentina
places.description: The first church in the city, founded by Juan de Garay in 1573. A historical and architectural icon.

places.name: Jewish Museum Hinenu
places.description: A museum dedicated to the history and culture of the Jewish community in the Santa Fe region.

places.name: Botanical Garden Ing. Lorenzo Parodi
places.description: A green space with a wide variety of native and exotic plant species.

places.name: Suspension Bridge (Ingeniero Marcial Candioti)
places.address: Av. de los 7 Jefes 3500, Santa Fe, Argentina
places.description: Historic bridge connecting the banks of the Setúbal lagoon, inaugurated in 1928.

places.name: San Francisco Convent and Museum
places.description: Catholic convent founded in 1673, declared a National Historic Monument.

places.name: Provincial Historical Museum Brigadier General Estanislao López
places.description: Museum preserving objects and documents from provincial and national history.

places.name: Juan de Garay Park
places.description: Large urban park with lakes, trails, and recreational areas.

places.name: Costa Litoral Catamaran Tours
places.description: Catamaran tours along the Paraná River, offering panoramic views of the city.
